- **Alpha Mismatch**: Meshes are excluded if their alpha state does not match the pass configuration (`transparency`).
- **Precision**: Floating point precision in vertex positions may cause z-fighting if voxel size is very small or camera is far.
- **Time Complexity**: $O(V)$ where $V$ is the number of visible voxels.
Preparation is $O(V)$ for batching, and rendering is $O(B)$ where $B$ is the number of batches (draw calls).
- **Memory Complexity**: $O(V)$ for storing vertex and index buffers.
Skinned rendering adds overhead for joint transformations.
- **Strengths**: Simple to implement, supports standard PBR materials, easy to integrate with existing rendering pipelines.
Not suitable for very large dense volumes without sparse optimization.
- **When to use**: Small to medium voxel scenes, debugging, or when PBR materials are required.
- **When not to use**: Very large dense volumes, real-time applications with strict performance constraints on draw calls.
The method is derived from implementations in voxel rendering engines, specifically those using the Amethyst game engine framework and custom voxel libraries.
